text:
mia: Quick thread for a fresh angle: we need a battlebox (battlecard + playbook) that tests two hero messages A/B: econ-focused vs reliability-focused. Goal: which drives more AE-qualified demo requests from webinar registrants. Webinar date 2024-10-02.
rafael: Love the split test idea. For A: lead with unit economics (cost/token + steady throughput). For B: lead with reliability (p95, fallbacks, SLA).
june: I'll build a 1-pg battlecard template that supports both variants and includes 3 short objection handlers tailored to procurement, infra, and product teams.
tori: Routing/rules: registrant -> if role contains "Platform"/"Infra" OR company_size >= 500 -> AE_queue. But for the test, tag registrants with hero_variant=A or B so SDRs can report conversion metrics. EU leads -> EU queue.
jamal-sdr: Need replayable AE script for each variant and two email flows (invite + post-webinar nurture). Also want a 30s pitch for SDR voicemails aligned to variant.
bench-bot: (upload) latest benchmark CSV -> https://storage.redwood/bench/serve-vs-apis-oct2024.csv
mia: Bench top-lines for copy: median latency 80ms (Redwood) vs 200ms (cloud API); cost/token $0.0010 vs $0.0030; p95 stability across region failovers. Keep phrasing conservative and cite appendix.
june: For the battlecard I will include a tiny decision tree: "If latency critical -> Redwood hosted/dedicated; if regulatory -> private; if prototype -> hosted API." Also add one-row ROI calc sample.
rafael: Webinar plan: panel with PM + SE + a customer ops speaker (anonymized) showing a failover scenario + short live demo of a p95 graph. Keep demo under 6m. We'll record both variants intro to measure which headline keeps attention.
tori: HubSpot pseudo-rule for tagging variant:
```
assign_based_on_role_and_size()
if registrant.source_hero_choice == "A" -> tag: hero_A
else -> tag: hero_B
```
And then routing rules as usual.
jamal-sdr: Pre-webinar email (variant fragments) I'll draft: A emphasizes ROI bullets; B emphasizes SLA & incident avoidance bullets. Post-webinar playbook will include AE handoff checklist fields: expected QPS, current cost per 1M tokens, private_deploy_interest.
bench-bot: Reminder: final CSV upload scheduled at 5512349890.
mia: Also want a short "battlebox" internal one-pager for AEs with negotiation prompts for procurement: 1) price match ask -> show steady-state unit economics + trial offer; 2) SLA/penalty ask -> show rollback/fallback policy; 3) private deploy timeline ask -> typical lead times. Keep each prompt one line + suggested doc to attach.
june: I'll add micro-copy for each objection so SDRs can hand it off quickly. Also include 3 clips for SDR outreach (30s highlight reels, one per variant + demo clip).
rafael: Add tracking waterfall: impressions -> registrants -> variant tag -> AE-qualified demos. We'll A/B significance test after 2k registrants or 4 weeks.
tori: I'll implement tagging + EU routing and set SLA for EU leads 24h. Also flag leads saying "private deploy" for SE follow-up.
jamal-sdr: Quick rebut lines (one-liners) for common pushback:
- "We already use cloud APIs": "Cloud gives compute; Redwood gives serving predictability, fallbacks, and unit-economics controls."
- "This seems synthetic": "See appendix + replayable demo using customer-like traces. We can run a free performance audit."
- "Vendor lock-in": "We support private deployments and clear data exit paths; SE can share migration playbook."

mia: Owners: june = battlecard + AE battlebox; rafael = webinar script + stats; jamal-sdr = emails + SDR playbook; tori = HubSpot tagging + routing; product = benchmark sign-off. Check-in 48h.
june: Drafts will be in Notion: https://notion.redwood/marketing/battlebox/oct2024-drafts. Ping product for numbers sign-off.
mia: Great. Keep language customer-impact first. We'll avoid absolute multipliers and always link appendix. Thanks team! :tada:
